A '''member''' of the [[Wheel Security Force]], the force which maintained order on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], acted as an informant for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. After a [[message pod]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']] was found near the Wheel and brought to the station, the informant provided the bureau with a full copy of all the data in the pod before it was given its intended recipients, the tech company [[IsoTech]].<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The informant was first mentioned [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
